overview.text: The Army detonated nearly five tons of lead-based explosives at an Iowa plant; early lead readings are described as promising while testing continues.
The administration plans new tariffs on 14 economies, including China, the EU and Brazil, over subsidized production, amid legal obstacles and scrutiny from an incoming Democratic-led Congress.
Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO after Trump pushed for it, effectively overriding the board, and lawmakers are demanding answers.
China is investigating Shanghai party chief Chen Jining, the fourth Politburo member probed since 2025.
The U.S. paused joint military operations with Ecuador while it investigates a raid that killed an accused gang leader.
A freeze warning covers San Antonio through Thanksgiving morning, and the airport expects nearly 20,000 passengers today.

stories.headline: Freeze warning issued for San Antonio through Thanksgiving morning
stories.summary: A freeze warning covers San Antonio, the I-35 corridor and nearby counties, with near-freezing temperatures before sunny skies on Thanksgiving.
stories.why: Protect plants, pets and anyone traveling or outdoors early.

stories.headline: Nearly 20,000 passengers expected at San Antonio airport today
stories.summary: The Thanksgiving travel rush brings heavy traffic to San Antonio International Airport.
stories.why: Plan extra time if you are flying.

stories.headline: San Antonio road closures and Black Friday store hours announced
stories.summary: Drivers face Thanksgiving and Black Friday road closures, and some stores will open early.
stories.why: Helps you plan weekend driving and shopping.

stories.headline: Army detonates nearly five tons of explosives at Iowa plant
stories.summary: The Army detonated degrading lead-based explosives at a munitions plant in Iowa on Wednesday, after days of back-and-forth between politicians and courts.
stories.why: Residents fear a lead dust cloud; testing of air, water and soil continues.

stories.headline: Administration to impose new tariffs on China, EU, Brazil and others
stories.summary: The U.S. plans tariffs on 14 economies it accuses of subsidizing industries to overproduce. The move comes amid legal obstacles and scrutiny from an incoming Democratic-led Congress.
stories.why: Tariffs can raise prices and strain trade relationships.

stories.headline: Plane crash off Mississippi coast kills six, including two children
stories.summary: A small plane crashed off the Mississippi coast, killing six people. An investigation is underway.

stories.headline: Deal Signed to Sell Lukoil’s Foreign Assets, but Without Envoys’ Business Associates
stories.summary: Valuable properties belonging to the Russian energy giant will be sold to an American-led consortium. But Middle Eastern business contacts of the peace negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are no longer part of the buyer group.

stories.headline: C.I.A. Waterboarded More Detainees Than It Admitted, F.B.I. Interview Suggests
stories.summary: The apparent disclosure was included in files released in response to a New York Times lawsuit. The release also shed light on C.I.A. officials’ fears about possible prosecutions.

stories.headline: Army wants to resume training flights near site of collision
stories.summary: An Army helicopter on a training mission collided with an American Airlines passenger jet on approach at DCA, killing all aboard both aircraft, in January 2025.

stories.headline: China investigates Shanghai party chief Chen Jining
stories.summary: Chen, a Politburo member seen as a contender for higher office, is the fourth Politburo member investigated since 2025, Xinhua announced.
stories.why: Signals continuing purges in the top ranks of Xi Jinping's leadership.

stories.headline: U.S. pauses joint military operations with Ecuador
stories.summary: The administration halted joint operations while investigating an Ecuadorean operation that killed an accused gang leader.

stories.headline: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
stories.summary: The US is planning tariffs on 14 economies it accuses of using subsidies to help their industries overproduce.

stories.headline: Trump pushes Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: Huang returned as CEO after the board said he would not. Governance experts say Trump effectively overrode the board. Huang apologized to employees and said he is in therapy.
stories.why: Shows presidential influence over a major company central to AI.

stories.headline: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy 1 million satellites
stories.summary: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative.

stories.headline: EA adds AI-generated John Motson to FC 27 video game
stories.summary: The AI-generated Motson will appear in the game on 26 November, with the consent of his son and wife.

stories.headline: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
stories.summary: Despite widespread concern from residents ahead of the blast, officials say that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.

stories.headline: Why has China sent the first Pakistani astronaut to space?
stories.summary: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali – the first Pakistani to reach orbit – greeted with Chinese ‘space handshake’ at Tiangong station China has flown the first foreign astronaut to its Tiangong space station, starting what it says will be the…

stories.headline: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
stories.summary: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago

stories.headline: What to know before using AI agents for Black Friday shopping
stories.summary: 59% of U.S. shoppers plan to use AI for holiday shopping this weekend, according to the National Retail Federation

stories.headline: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
stories.summary: US owner Gordon Brothers rejected at least two last-ditch bids for UK budget retailer Do you work for Poundland?

stories.headline: Martha Firestone Ford, Owner of Detroit Lions, Dies at 101
stories.summary: Mrs. Ford, who took over the team after the 2014 death of her husband, William Clay Ford Sr., was one of a handful of female owners in the N.F.L.

stories.headline: Fisilau starts as England change five for All Blacks rematch
stories.summary: Exeter back row Greg Fisilau will make his first England start in one of five changes to their XV to face New Zealand on Saturday.

stories.headline: AD’s first 100 days show Purdue needs progress in NIL spending. What does that look like?
stories.summary: Purdue athletic director touched on what he’s seen in his department across his first 100 days, successes and improvements needed, and a call for fans.

stories.headline: Trinity Rodman out of USWNT’s World Cup qualifier due to shoulder injury
stories.summary: Trinity Rodman has withdrawn from the U.S. women’s national team roster for the Concacaf W Championship, U.S. Soccer announced.

stories.headline: In ‘Blade Runner 2099,’ the Future Is Hot and Sticky
stories.summary: As a longtime fan of the films, Blade Runner 2099 showrunner Silka Luisa says she was more excited than scared when it came to adapting the series for TV.

stories.headline: See How the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Came Together Over 5 Years
stories.summary: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is celebrating its 100th procession through New York City this year — and organizers say they are going big with 100 inflatables, including new characters.

stories.headline: Hundreds complain about I'm A Celebrity after Mariella Frostrup called AJ Odudu 'aggressive'
stories.summary: Ofcom receives 887 complaints, while media figures accuse Frostrup of using ‘microaggression’ against Odudu Almost 900 people have complained to the UK’s media regulator about an episode of ITV’s I’m A Celebrity … Get Me Out of Here!
